name: 9 Pcs Islamic Wooden Sticky Tiles Set – Bismillah Alhamdulillah Wall Art Gallery (5x7 Inches)
description: Transform your living space with this beautiful 9-Piece Islamic Wooden Sticky Frames Set.
seoDescription: Transform your living space with this beautiful 9-Piece Islamic Wooden Sticky Frames Set.
detailHtml:
Elevate your home decor and keep your heart connected to your faith with our premium 9-Piece Islamic Wooden Sticky Tiles Set. This curated gallery wall collection features a striking balance of contemporary art abstract backdrops—including high-contrast smoke textures in rich red, blue, and gold tones—paired perfectly with clean, classic Islamic typography and sacred calligraphy layouts. The collection serves as an everyday visual reminder to begin your tasks in the name of Allah, stay grateful for your blessings, and place your ultimate trust in His divine plans.

Each individual wooden tile measures exactly 5x7 inches, offering an incredibly versatile configuration pattern. You can mount them closely together in a stunning diamond or rectangular cross shape exactly as pictured, or split them up to decorate different corners of your home, such as your hallway, prayer room, living room, or study.

Engineered for the modern home, these sleek, frameless tiles are made on lightweight yet highly rigid engineered wood. The highlight of this set is its specialized sticky tape backing. Say goodbye to the loud noise of hammers, cracked plaster walls, and messy drilling cleanups. Simply peel off the protective film layer and firmly press the tiles onto any clean, flat surface. The high-definition prints are fade-resistant and moisture-protected, ensuring that your spiritual gallery remains vibrant and beautiful for years to come.

Key Features

  • Complete 9-Piece Gallery Set: Comes with 9 uniquely designed matching wooden tiles that blend modern abstract splash art with classic spiritual calligraphy.
  • Hassle-Free Peel & Stick Mounts: Equipped with premium sticky adhesive tape backings that stay firmly on the wall without requiring any nails, hooks, or drilling holes.
  • Frameless Wooden Tile Build: Crafted on high-quality, lightweight engineered wood panels that sit flat against the wall for a clean, borderless look.
  • Perfect 5x7 Inch Dimensions: Each individual tile measures 5x7 inches, making it easy to create a prominent focus wall layout without cluttering your room space.
  • HD Waterproof Printing: Uses high-definition digital colors with deep ink saturation that resists fading over time and wipes clean easily with a dry cloth.
  • Meaningful Islamic Gift Choice: An exceptional and thoughtful gift option for housewarmings, Eid celebrations, weddings, or personal bedroom updates.

name: Hajj Niyat Box – Premium Islamic Savings Tracker & Goal-Oriented Money Box - Non-Assembled
description: Start your sacred journey with the Hajj Niyat Box, a purposefully designed savings tool to help you reach your pilgrimage goals. This elegant tracker features a comprehensive grid of various amounts,
seoDescription: Start your sacred journey with the Hajj Niyat Box, a purposefully designed savings tool to help you reach…
detailHtml:
Transform your spiritual aspirations into an organized plan with the Hajj Niyat Box. This unique savings tracker is designed for those intending to perform Hajj, providing a clear and motivating way to accumulate the necessary funds. The front panel features an extensive grid populated with hundreds of individual currency denominations, ranging from smaller amounts like 200 and 500 to larger contributions like 9800. By ticking off or covering these numbers as you deposit money, you gain a sense of accomplishment and a visual representation of your growing "Niyat" (intention).

The box is built with a sleek, professional finish, featuring a high-contrast black face with white text for easy readability. At the bottom right, the ultimate milestone of 1,100,000/- is clearly displayed, serving as a constant reminder of your final objective. Whether you save daily, weekly, or monthly, this tracker accommodates flexible saving habits while ensuring you stay on the path toward your spiritual milestone. It is more than just a money box; it is a dedicated companion for one of the most important journeys of a lifetime.

Key Features

  • Goal-Oriented Design: Specifically designed to track savings toward a total target of 1,100,000/- for Hajj.
  • Comprehensive Tracking Grid: Features a diverse range of denominations (200, 500, 1000, 2000, and more) to suit various saving capacities.

Customization Options

Water Resistance

For those with an active lifestyle, the S8 Ultra’s water-resistant design is a game-changer. It can withstand splashes, rain, and even a dip in the pool, ensuring it won’t hold you back from any activity.

Security Features

Your data and privacy are a top priority with the S8 Ultra Smart Watch. It includes features like PIN protection and automatic screen lock when removed from your wrist, ensuring that your personal information remains secure. description: This is a versatile and feature-packed smartwatch designed with a 49mm housing and a durable Space Aluminum Case. The key highlight is the "10 in 1 Strap"
seoDescription: This is a versatile and feature-packed smartwatch designed with a 49mm housing and a durable Space Aluminum…
detailHtml:
This is a comprehensive smartwatch package designed to offer a blend of style, connectivity, and essential health features in a highly customizable format.

​ Design and Customization

  • ​Case & Build: Features a large 49MM Housing with a durable and lightweight Space Aluminum Case (also referred to as Zinc Alloy/Titanium finish), often sporting real screws on the back and a strap lock mechanism for a secure fit.
  • ​Display: Equipped with a vibrant and spacious IPS or AMOLED Display (typically 2.0-2.2 inches) with a high resolution for crisp, clear visuals. The screen often features a near-bezel-less ("Infinite") design.
  • ​The 10-in-1 Advantage: The main selling point is the included set of ten (10) interchangeable straps in various materials (like silicone, ocean, woven, leather, and steel) and colors, allowing the user to match the watch to any outfit or activity.

​ Core Functions & Connectivity

  • ​Bluetooth Calling: Built-in speaker and microphone enable you to make and receive phone calls directly from the watch when connected to your smartphone (Android or iOS).
  • ​Notifications: Stay connected with real-time alerts for calls, SMS, and popular social media apps.
  • ​App Integration: Connects to a companion app (often HiWatch Pro, QRunning, or Maitu Fit) to manage settings, view health data, and download customized 3D watch faces.
  • ​Hardware Features: Includes a fully functional rotating crown (side button) and a lag-free menu for smooth operation.

​ Health and Fitness Tracking

  • ​Health Monitoring: Acts as a complete health assistant, typically monitoring:
  • ​Heart Rate
  • ​Blood Oxygen (SpO_2)
  • ​Sleep Tracking
  • ​Pedometer (Step counter and calorie burned)
  • ​Sports Modes: Includes multiple pre-set Sports Modes to track specific activities like running, cycling, walking, and more.
  • ​Other Features: May include a Sedentary Reminder and an ECG monitor (though accuracy can vary in budget models).

​Power and Durability

  • ​Charging: Supports convenient Magnetic Wireless Charging.
  • ​Battery Life: Equipped with a powerful battery (e.g., 380mAh), offering an average of 2-3 days of usage and 5-7 days of standby time.
  • ​Water Resistance: Typically rated IP67 Life Waterproof or splash-resistant, making it suitable for everyday use (like hand washing and light rain) but not recommended for swimming, diving, or bathing.

name: SmartGel Cockroach Killer Gel (20g) | Professional Strength, Odorless & Mess-Free Solution | Kills Within 72 Hours for Home & Kitchen Use
description: Eliminate infestations effortlessly with SmartGel. This advanced chemical formula is 100% odorless, fume-free, and mess-free. Designed for maximum efficiency, it targets cockroaches at the source and provides a complete kill within 72 hours, keeping your environment clean and hygienic.
seoDescription: Eliminate infestations effortlessly with SmartGel.
detailHtml:
Take back your home from unwanted pests with SmartGel Cockroach Killer. Engineered with high-performance active chemical technology, this gel bait is the ultimate solution for those who want professional results without the hassle of traditional sprays or powders.

Unlike messy aerosols, SmartGel is easy to apply in hard-to-reach cracks, crevices, and corners where cockroaches hide. The formula is specifically designed to be "Environment Friendly," ensuring it is safe for use in kitchens and bathrooms without leaving behind toxic fumes or strong odors. Whether you are dealing with a small nuisance or a persistent infestation, SmartGel provides a long-lasting barrier to keep your living space pest-free.

Key Features:

  • Rapid Action: Total elimination starts within 72 hours.

  • Mess-Free: No dripping or staining; remains where you apply it.

Key Responsibilities

To ensure the product works effectively, follow these application responsibilities:

  1. Identify High-Traffic Areas: Apply the gel in dark, moist areas such as under sinks, behind refrigerators, and inside cupboard hinges.
  2. Small-Dot Application: Place small, pea-sized drops (approx. 3-4 drops per square meter) rather than one long line to maximize bait attraction.
  3. Prevent Contamination: Do not spray other insecticides or aerosols near the gel, as this may repel the cockroaches and prevent them from eating the bait.

name: JSL-W302 Portable Mesh Nebulizer: Quiet, Low-Power Personal Inhaler for Efficient Respiratory Care
description: This is a quiet, portable, and low-power mesh nebulizer designed for efficient medication delivery. The packaging includes the device and an instruction manual (JSL-W302). It is ideal for personal respiratory care on the go.
seoDescription: JSL-W302 Portable Mesh Nebulizer: Quiet, Low-Power Personal Inhaler for Efficient Respiratory Care.
detailHtml:
The JSL-W302 Mesh Nebulizer is a modern, compact device intended for aerosolizing liquid medication for inhalation, targeting the treatment of various respiratory conditions. Its key advantage lies in its use of mesh technology, which ensures quiet operation and highly efficient, fine-mist delivery of medication deep into the respiratory tract.

Key Features & User Responsibilities:

  • Quiet Operation: Unlike traditional compressor nebulizers, the mesh technology significantly reduces noise, making treatments discreet and comfortable, especially for children or during sleep.
  • User Responsibility: Ensure the device is used in a clean, quiet environment to fully appreciate the low-noise feature.
  • Portable and Compact Design: The small, handheld size and low power consumption make it easy to carry in a bag or pocket, offering flexibility for use at home, work, or while traveling.
  • User Responsibility: Maintain the device's battery (if applicable) and store it properly in a protective case when traveling to prevent damage.
  • Efficient Medication Delivery: The mesh atomization process creates ultra-fine particles, optimizing the therapeutic effect of inhaled medications.
  • User Responsibility: Strictly follow the dosage and type of medication prescribed by a healthcare professional. Only use solutions specifically approved for nebulization.
  • Simple Operation: The device is designed for easy assembly and use, typically featuring a one-button start/stop function. An instruction manual is included for guidance.
  • User Responsibility: Carefully read and follow the 'INSTRUCTION MANUAL (JSL-W302)' for proper setup, cleaning, and maintenance procedures to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
  • Hygiene and Maintenance: Regular cleaning is crucial for mesh nebulizers to prevent clogging and bacterial growth.
